title: Reserve room for a larger shape margin
html: A clear layout leaves room for both artwork and words. Follow the first lines as they pass the blue shape. Their starting positions change with the available space. Below the float, the paragraph returns to its full width. The artwork keeps the same size throughout the comparison.
